mapper.select: select count(*) as totalOrders, coalesce(sum(case when status = #{completed} then 1 else 0 end), 0) as validOrders, coalesce(sum(case when status = #{completed} then amount else 0 end), 0) as turnover from orders where
select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from orders where status = #{status} and

SELECT o.* FROM orders o
AND o.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{number}, '%')
AND o.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND o.status = #{query.status} AND o.order_time >= #{begin} AND o.order_time <= #{end}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_risk_result rr WHERE rr.order_id = o.id AND rr.evaluated_at = (SELECT MAX(r2.evaluated_at) FROM order_risk_result r2 WHERE r2.order_id = o.id) AND rr.risk_level = #{riskLevel})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_risk_result rr WHERE rr.order_id = o.id AND rr.evaluated_at = (SELECT MAX(r2.evaluated_at) FROM order_risk_result r2 WHERE r2.order_id = o.id) AND rr.risk_score >= #{query.minRiskScore})
ORDER BY o.order_time DESC, o.id DESC
